Fixed. The bug was in `GroupByQueryQueryToolChest.pullFromCache` (processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/groupby/GroupByQueryQueryToolChest.java:642): the post-aggregator restore loop never incremented `postPos` (and its `postItr` never advanced), so when restoring rows from the result-level cache, every cached post-aggregation value was written into the first post-agg slot — with a single post-aggregate metric this was invisible, but with multiple ones the values were corrupted (e.g. `a2=31548, a3=NULL` in the reported query).

The loop now iterates over `query.getPostAggregatorSpecs()` and reads one cached value per spec, throwing an `ISE` if the cached entry runs out.
